title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Campus Rainwater Harvesting Process
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which rainwater collected on a university campus is treated and reused. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 1 流程图练习。请先花约 3 分钟读图，找出流程的起点、终点以及各阶段之间的先后关系，再规划 4 段左右的结构：引言（改写题目）、总体概述（2–3 个主要特征）、主体段（按阶段描述步骤与变化）。注意使用恰当的被动语态与顺序连接词，并比较不同阶段在水量、用途或处理程度上的差异。所有场景与数据均为模拟，非官方雅思试卷。

figure.title: Campus Rainwater Harvesting and Reuse Cycle
steps: Rain falls on the roofs of campus buildings and is channelled into gutters.
Gutters direct the water through downpipes into an underground storage tank.
A coarse mesh screen at the tank inlet removes leaves and large debris.
Stored water is pumped to a filtration unit that traps fine sediment.
Filtered water passes through a UV disinfection chamber.
Treated water is held in a clean cistern beneath the sports centre.
Cistern water supplies toilet flushing and irrigation of campus gardens.
Surplus treated water overflows into a retention pond that recharges groundwater.
